name: routes a purchase row to the order, selecting it first when it is loaded
fullName: useMyActivity — payments history routes a purchase row to the order, selecting it first when it is loaded
description:
My Activity hub: who sees which tab, the header strip, the "add a bank" prompt,
and where each row in the payment history goes. Every request is skipped for
guests and every seller request for non-sellers.
